observations: Vintage-style microwave oven with a cream-colored plastic frame.
The brand 'Russell Hobbs' is printed on the upper left of the glass door in photo 0.
The control panel features a digital display, a rotary dial, and several buttons.
The unit is shown installed in a white shelving unit.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ELECTRON WORLD' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The microwave may not heat or power on.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in and the interior light turning on.

risks.risk: The door seal or interior cavity may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the door gasket and the inside of the cavity.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged door seal

risks.risk: The internal heating element or magnetron may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the microwave operating and a thermometer inside showing a temperature rise.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the microwave plugged in and the interior light turning on.
Photo of the door gasket and the inside cavity.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the unit.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
